notes.title: Tortuga Release Live Stream
notes.notes:
[h1]Tortuga Release Live Stream[/h1]

[i]Pirates![/i]

Want to see how your fellow pirates are faring on their journey over the deep seas? 
Then the Release Stream for Tortuga is just for you, me hearties – hoist the mizzen and engage!

Join us with Wladimir and our [b]special guest Christian[/b] from the development team as they start a new game and answer questions from the community. 

[b]Tune in on launch day Tuesday, February 13th at 6 p.m. CET![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604250/Tortuga__A_Pirates_Tale/
